preconditions.description: The lengths of s_1, s_2, and virus are between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() for c in s_1) and all(c.isupper() for c in s_2) and all(c.isupper() for c in virus)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_1, s_2, and virus are uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a common subsequence of s_1 and s_2.
The output does not contain virus as a substring.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == max(len(subseq) for subseq in common_subsequences(s_1, s_2) if virus not in subseq)
postconditions.description: The output is the longest common subsequence of s_1 and s_2 that does not contain virus as a substring.
